classes.name: action
classes.label: action
classes.definition: event announced, initiated or carried out by an organization that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues and may have a material impact on that entity's stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

classes.name: action classification scheme
classes.label: action classification scheme
classes.definition: scheme for classifying the kinds of actions and events that may be announced, initiated or carried out by an organization that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues

classes.name: action classifier
classes.label: action classifier
classes.definition: classifier that distinguishes the kinds of actions and events that may be announced, initiated or carried out by an organization that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues, such as income-oriented events

classes.name: action status
classes.label: action status
classes.definition: state of some action at some point in time

classes.name: business strategy classifier
classes.label: business strategy classifier
classes.definition: classifier of corporate actions that involve improving liquidity or changing the overall structure of the organization through diversification, combining and closing parts of the business, etc, to increase long-term profitability

classes.name: change action
classes.label: change action
classes.definition: corporate action to disseminate information regarding a change further described in the corporate action details

classes.name: class action
classes.label: class action
classes.definition: corporate action involving a situation where interested parties seek restitution for financial loss

classes.name: consent solicitation
classes.label: consent solicitation
classes.definition: corporate action that is a procedure that aims to obtain consent of holder to a proposal by the issuer or a third party without convening a meeting

classes.name: corporate action
classes.label: corporate action
classes.definition: action carried out by or specifically relating to a legal entity that may affect the securities it issues and may have a material impact on its stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

classes.name: disclosure action
classes.label: disclosure action
classes.definition: corporate action involving a request for holders or beneficial owners to disclose their name, location and holdings of any issue to the issuer

classes.name: divestiture
classes.label: divestiture
classes.definition: corporate action involving the sales of subsidiary business interests or investments

classes.name: income-oriented classifier
classes.label: income-oriented classifier
classes.definition: classifier of corporate actions that impacts income to shareholders

classes.name: legal form change
classes.label: legal form change
classes.definition: corporate action indicating a modification of the legal form of the organization

classes.name: liquidation
classes.label: liquidation
classes.definition: corporate action related to winding up a business, including but not limited to distribution of cash, assets, or both

classes.name: mandatory corporate action
classes.label: mandatory corporate action
classes.definition: action initiated by the board of directors of a corporation that affects all shareholders

classes.name: mandatory with choice corporate action
classes.label: mandatory with choice corporate action
classes.definition: mandatory corporate action where shareholders are given an opportunity to choose among several options

classes.name: market action
classes.label: market action
classes.definition: action that is initiated by a market, such as a securities exchange, that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues and may have a material impact on that entity's stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

classes.name: merger / acquisition
classes.label: merger / acquisition
classes.definition: corporate action involving the consolidation of legal entities or assets

classes.name: notification
classes.label: notification
classes.definition: corporate action involving information provided by the issuer having no accounting/financial impact on the holder

classes.name: organization address change
classes.label: organization address change
classes.definition: information action that provides details of address changes for a legal entity

classes.name: organization name change
classes.label: organization name change
classes.definition: information action that provides details of name changes for a legal entity

classes.name: priority issue
classes.label: priority issue
classes.definition: corporate action that is a public offer where, due to a limited amount of securities available, priority is given to existing shareholders

classes.name: regulatory action
classes.label: regulatory action
classes.definition: action initiated by a regulatory agency that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues and may have a material impact on that entity's stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

classes.name: spin off
classes.label: spin off
classes.definition: corporate action involving the distribution of subsidiary stock to the shareholders of the parent company without a surrender of shares

classes.name: voluntary corporate action
classes.label: voluntary corporate action
classes.definition: event in which the shareholders elect to participate and must respond in order for the issuer to process the action

classes.name: action group
classes.label: action group
classes.definition: classifier that differentiates corporate actions based on a GLEIF specific grouping

classes.name: bond default event
classes.label: bond default event
classes.definition: corporate action which indicates a failure by the issuer to perform obligations defined as default events under the bond agreement and that have not been remedied

classes.name: bonus issue
classes.label: bonus issue
classes.definition: corporate action in which security holders are awarded additional assets free of payment from the issuer in proportion to their holding

classes.name: bonus rights issue
classes.label: bonus rights issue
classes.definition: A Rights Issue in which the rights are given to the holders of the referenced shares for free.

classes.name: bonus share plan distribution
classes.label: bonus share plan distribution
classes.definition: Event in which shares are issued from the Share Premium Reserve of the company and are considered as a capital distribution rather than a disbursement of income, with different tax implications. SWIFT Definition (adapted above) "Typically found in Australia, shares are issued from the Share Premium Reserve of the company and are considered as a capital distribution rather than a disbursement of income, with different tax implications." To be researches further. There are certainly Share Plans in Australia, where you can take a dividend as shares. Thewse would be in the nature of Bonus Shares. They are a tradeoff from cash dividends. Other terms to model: A "Scheme of Arrangment" - does this change the capital reserves or is it just another word for restructure. An arrangement with the company's debtors, and coule potentially change the capital base by converting the debt to shares (see other diagram note with these in).

classes.name: call on intermediate securities
classes.label: call on intermediate securities
classes.definition: corporate action that involves a call or exercise on nil paid securities or intermediate securities resulting from an intermediate securities distribution (RHDI)

classes.name: cancellation of shares
classes.label: cancellation of shares
classes.definition: The cancellation of shares. Further Notes Only possible with shares not publicly issued i.e. treasury shares

classes.name: capital distribution
classes.label: capital distribution
classes.definition: corporate action that pays shareholders an amount in cash issued from the issuer's capital account

classes.name: capital gains distribution
classes.label: capital gains distribution
classes.definition: corporate action that distributes profits resulting from the sale of company assets to shareholders

classes.name: cash dividend action
classes.label: cash dividend action
classes.definition: corporate action that distributes cash to shareholders in proportion to their equity holding

classes.name: change of security trading status event
classes.label: change of security trading status event
classes.definition: An event in which the trading status of a tradable security changes.

classes.name: change to smallest negotiable unit
classes.label: change to smallest negotiable unit
classes.definition: Modification of the smallest negotiable unit of shares in order to obtain a new negotiable unit. SWIFT:SMAL

classes.name: conversion action
classes.label: conversion action
classes.definition: corporate action involving conversion of securities (generally convertible bonds or preferred shares) into another form of securities (usually common shares) at a pre-stated price/ratio

classes.name: conversion suspension action
classes.label: conversion suspension action
classes.definition: Suspension of conversion of securities, generally a couple of weeks before a meeting takes place. SWIFT = SCOP

classes.name: corporate action obligation
classes.label: corporate action obligation
classes.definition: An obligation related to the holding of a Security.

classes.name: corporate action securities delivery obligation
classes.label: corporate action securities delivery obligation
classes.definition: Some obligation to deliver some security in the thr context of corporate actions. All cash proceeds and security proceeds can be represented a s acontractual obligation. Where does that obligation arise? Usually in the Contract itself - but there may be other answers to this. Defines what has to be delivered. or paid. Entitlement meanwhile is a calculation based on the Contract.

classes.name: corporate change of status event
classes.label: corporate change of status event
classes.definition: Some change to the status of some security.

classes.name: coupon strip
classes.label: coupon strip
classes.definition: Coupon stripping is the process whereby interest coupons for future payment dates are separated from the security corpus that entitles the holder to the principal repayment.

classes.name: decrease in value action
classes.label: decrease in value action
classes.definition: corporate action resulting in a reduction of face value of a share or the value of fund assets

classes.name: dividend option action
classes.label: dividend option action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves distribution of a dividend to shareholders with a choice of benefit to receive

classes.name: dividend reinvestment action
classes.label: dividend reinvestment action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves a dividend payment whereby holders can keep cash or have the cash reinvested into additional shares in the issuing company

classes.name: drawing
classes.label: drawing
classes.definition: Redemption in part before the scheduled final maturity date of a security.

classes.name: dutch auction
classes.label: dutch auction
classes.definition: corporate action by a party wishing to acquire a security

classes.name: exchange action
classes.label: exchange action
classes.definition: corporate action that reflects an exchange of holdings for other securities and/or cash

classes.name: formal offer
classes.label: formal offer
classes.definition: corporate action involving an offer to a holder, potential holder, or other intersted party, to enter into a trade which is or would be legally binding on the part of the party making the offer (the offeror).

classes.name: full call early redemption action
classes.label: full call early redemption action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves redemption of an entire issue outstanding of securities prior to maturity

classes.name: interest payment action
classes.label: interest payment action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves distribution of a regular interest payment to holders of an interest-bearing asset

classes.name: interest payment in kind
classes.label: interest payment in kind
classes.definition: Interest payment, in any kind except cash, distributed to holders of an interest bearing asset. SWIFT = PINK

classes.name: interest payment with principal
classes.label: interest payment with principal
classes.definition: A payment of a portion of the principal of an interest bearing asset, in addition to the interest payment. SWIFT = PRII

classes.name: interest rate adjustment
classes.label: interest rate adjustment
classes.definition: Scheduled change to the coupon rate for a floating or adjustable rate security.

classes.name: intermediate securities distribution
classes.label: intermediate securities distribution
classes.definition: corporate action involving the distribution of intermediate securities or privilege that gives the holder the right to take part in a future event

classes.name: listing status delisting message
classes.label: listing status delisting message
classes.definition: Security is no longer able to comply with the listing requirements of a stock exchange and is removed from official board quotation.

classes.name: odd lot offer
classes.label: odd lot offer
classes.definition: Offer by issuer to allow holders of an odd lot of a security to order a commission-free transaction at market price, to sell the odd lot, or to buy an amount of shares which will bring the position to a round lot (board lot). SWIFT = ODLT

classes.name: pari-passu action
classes.label: pari-passu action
classes.definition: corporate action that occurs when securities with different characteristics become identical in all respects

classes.name: partial redemption with reduction of nominal value action
classes.label: partial redemption with reduction of nominal value action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves redemption of securities in part before their scheduled final maturity date with reduction of the nominal value of the securities

classes.name: partial redemption without reduction of nominal value action
classes.label: partial redemption without reduction of nominal value action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves redemption of securities in part before their scheduled final maturity date with no reduction in nominal value

classes.name: post-merger securities exchange
classes.label: post-merger securities exchange
classes.definition: corporate action that involves the exchange of outstanding securities, initiated by the issuer which may include options, as the result of two or more companies combining assets, that is, an external, third party company

classes.name: put redemption action
classes.label: put redemption action
classes.definition: corporate action involving early redemption of a security at the election of the holder subject to the terms and condition of the issue with no reduction in nominal value

classes.name: redemption at maturity action
classes.label: redemption at maturity action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves redemption of an entire issue outstanding of securities at final maturity

classes.name: redenomination action
classes.label: redenomination action
classes.definition: corporate action by which the unit (currency and/or nominal) of a security is restated

classes.name: repurchase offer
classes.label: repurchase offer
classes.definition: corporate action in which an offer is made to existing shareholders by the issuing company to repurchase equity or other securities convertible into equity

classes.name: reverse stock split
classes.label: reverse stock split
classes.definition: corporate action involving a decrease in a company's number of outstanding equities without any change in the shareholder's equity or the aggregate market value at the time of the split

classes.name: rights exercise event
classes.label: rights exercise event
classes.definition: Exercising the right to purchase the shares. Furhter Notes: This is an action on the part of the holder. SWIFT: Call/exercise on nil-paid securities/rights resulting from a rights distribution (RHDI) (To be used for the second event in case rights issue is dealt with in 2 events, first event being the RHDI).

classes.name: shares premium dividend action
classes.label: shares premium dividend action
classes.definition: corporate action that pays shareholders an amount in cash issued from the shares premium reserve

classes.name: stock dividend action
classes.label: stock dividend action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves distribution of a dividend to shareholders in the form of equities of the issuing corporation

classes.name: stock split
classes.label: stock split
classes.definition: corporate action involving an increase in a corporation's number of outstanding equities without any change in the shareholder's equity or the aggregate market value at the time of the split

classes.name: tender offer
classes.label: tender offer
classes.definition: corporate action involving an offer made to shareholders, normally by a third party, requesting them to sell (tender) or exchange their equities

classes.name: trading status active message
classes.label: trading status active message
classes.definition: Trading in security has commenced or security has been re-activated after a supsension in trading.

classes.name: trading status message
classes.label: trading status message
classes.definition: A message about trading status.

classes.name: trading status suspended message
classes.label: trading status suspended message
classes.definition: Trading in the security has been suspended.

classes.name: warrant exercise action
classes.label: warrant exercise action
classes.definition: corporate action that offers holders the option to buy (call warrant) or to sell (put warrant) a specific amount of stock, cash, or commodity, at a predetermined price, during a predetermined period of time (which usually corresponds to the life of the issue)

classes.name: worthless security action
classes.label: worthless security action
classes.definition: corporate action that involves booking out of valueless securities
